# Contamos

> Contamos is a shared ledger for people who share money: couples, flatmates, families, side projects or any group with a common pot. It keeps accounts, cards and cash across multiple currencies, fiat and crypto alike, and shows balances per currency without blending everything into one converted number.

A ledger logs income and expense transactions with tags, and every transaction stores the exchange rate of the day it happened. The free plan needs no card; Pro removes the free plan's account, member and transaction limits.

On every plan, AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT can connect to a ledger through a remote MCP server at https://contamos.xyz/mcp, signing in as the user, within the limits of each team's plan. They can read balances and reports, record and edit movements, and import a bank statement the user hands them after a dry run the user reviews. Assistants cannot change notification preferences: those are managed per person and per team in the app, under team settings, Notifications, so an assistant should send the user there.

## Pages

- [Homepage (English)](https://contamos.xyz/en): what Contamos does, how it works, pricing and frequently asked questions.
- [Homepage (Spanish)](https://contamos.xyz/es): the same page in Spanish.
- [Log in or sign up](https://contamos.xyz/login): create a free ledger or open an existing one.

## Docs

Every page is also available in Spanish at the same path under /es.

- [Introduction](https://contamos.xyz/en/docs/introduction.md): what Contamos is and how the docs are organised.
- [Quickstart](https://contamos.xyz/en/docs/quickstart.md): from signing up to a first transaction.
- [Accounts and currencies](https://contamos.xyz/en/docs/accounts-and-currencies.md): accounts, the currencies they hold, and balances per currency.
- [Transactions and transfers](https://contamos.xyz/en/docs/transactions-and-transfers.md): income, expenses, transfers between accounts, and CSV export.
- [Tags](https://contamos.xyz/en/docs/tags.md): labels that follow money across categories.
- [Exchange rates](https://contamos.xyz/en/docs/exchange-rates.md): the exchange rate every transaction stores, and typing your own.
- [Budgets](https://contamos.xyz/en/docs/budgets.md): monthly budgets per category or tag (Pro).
- [Recurring transactions](https://contamos.xyz/en/docs/recurring-transactions.md): rules that record a transaction on a schedule (Pro).
- [Members and roles](https://contamos.xyz/en/docs/members-and-roles.md): invitations, the owner, admin and member roles, and leaving a team.
- [Activity log](https://contamos.xyz/en/docs/activity-log.md): every change made inside a team (Pro).
- [Plans and limits](https://contamos.xyz/en/docs/plans-and-limits.md): what the Free plan allows and what Pro removes and adds.
- [Notifications](https://contamos.xyz/en/docs/notifications.md): the emails a team's Owner and Admins receive (member changes, budget alerts, recurring failures, the monthly summary), and how to turn each off or unsubscribe.
- [AI assistants](https://contamos.xyz/en/docs/ai-assistants.md): connecting Claude or ChatGPT, with example prompts.
